meta.name: bioservices
meta.description: Unified Python interface to 40+ bioinformatics services. Use when querying multiple databases (UniProt, KEGG, ChEMBL, Reactome) in a single workflow with consistent API. Best for cross-database analysis, ID mapping across services. For quick single-database lookups use gget; for sequence/file manipulation use biopython.

copy.tagline_en: Query and cross-analyze multiple bioinformatics databases through one unified interface
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to query multiple bio databases in one consistent workflow

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 通过 Python 包 bioservices 用同一套 API 访问约 40 个生物信息学在线服务，可在一次任务里跨库取数据、映射标识符、检索序列与通路、跑 BLAST 比对。
howto.when: 当你要在同一个工作流里查询多个生物数据库（如 UniProt、KEGG 等），或需要跨库分析、标识符映射时接管；单个数据库快查或序列文件处理不在其列。

howto.what_en: Installs the bioservices Python package, letting Claude reach ~40 bioinformatics web services through one consistent API for cross-database queries, identifier mapping, sequence, pathway and BLAST work.
howto.when_en: Use when you need several bio databases (UniProt, KEGG, ChEMBL, etc.) queried in one workflow, or when doing cross-database analysis and ID mapping. Not for single-database quick lookups.
